bla_cheesemonger.text: Cheddar, matured 90 metres down the old Big Pit. Wrapped in cloth, turned by hand, left alone in the dark. A bit like a miner, in a way, except the cheese gets better with age.
The mine air's cool, damp and steady, which is exactly what cheddar needs. Fancy a slice?
Diolch. Keep it cool, keep it damp and keep it away from the cat.
